anomalies.description: A man in a dark jacket is on the ground amid straw and debris, repeatedly striking or grappling with an unseen or obscured opponent; his body moves violently (e.g., f5: raising arms, f6: rolling, f9: legs flailing upward), consistent with active physical combat.

verification.reason: Frames f4–f11 show continuous dynamic struggle on the floor: f4 shows him crouched low, f5 he raises arms as if blocking or striking, f6 he rolls, f7–f8 he’s partially obscured but still moving, f9 shows legs kicking upward, f10–f11 he repositions—this sequence indicates mutual physical engagement, not one-sided abuse. No evidence of helplessness or restraint; motion suggests reciprocity.

anomalies.description: A man in a light suit places and maintains his hand on the chest/shoulder of another man while both stand facing forward, with subtle shifts in posture and gaze suggesting tense confrontation or restrained physical engagement.

verification.reason: From f13 to f20, the second man’s hand remains on the first man’s torso; the first man’s expression is tense and resistant, and slight postural changes (e.g., f19–f20: slight turn, f17–f18: subtle resistance) indicate ongoing physical tension—not passive contact. This meets the definition of Fighting as mutual physical engagement, even if non-striking (e.g., clinch, control attempt).
